headline: LG Projects Surge in Peruvian Air Conditioner Demand on El Niño
summary: LG expects air conditioner demand in Peru to grow between 10% and 20% driven by high temperatures from the El Niño phenomenon, potentially breaking import records.
why: Weather anomalies like El Niño disrupt agricultural supply chains and alter consumer demand patterns for electronics and cooling appliances.

impacts.name: LG
impacts.why: Higher seasonal demand for air conditioners may boost sales volumes for LG.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
